title: Learning angles for quantum approximate optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.23296v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) and its variants are leading algorithms to help solve challenging combinatorial optimization problems. QAOA maps these problems to Ising Hamiltonians such that their ground state is the desired solution. Candidate solutions are then drawn from a variational quantum circuit. The performance of QAOA hinges on a set of variational angles. However, finding good angles is an instance-specific and computationally expensive non-convex classical optimization task. Here, we learn the mapping from the problem instance to high-quality QAOA angles. Our learned models replace the per-instance optimization, that we call the solver, with a single forward pass that is several orders of magnitude faster than the solver with a near identical quality. translated_title: 学习量子近似优化的角度参数
translated_abstract: 量子近似优化算法（QAOA）及其变体是帮助解决具有挑战性的组合优化问题的领先算法。QAOA将这些问题映射到Ising哈密顿量上，使其基态即为所需的解，随后从变分量子电路中采样得到候选解。QAOA的性能取决于一组变分角度参数，然而寻找好的角度参数是一项针对具体实例、计算成本高昂的非凸经典优化任务。本文中，我们学习了从问题实例到高质量QAOA角度参数的映射。我们训练的模型用单次前向传播取代了逐实例的优化过程（我们称之为求解器），其速度比求解器快几个数量级，同时质量几乎相同。我们的模型还能进一步泛化到未见过的拓扑结构，例如Barabási-Albert网络和二维网格图。在量子硬件上的实验证实了QAOA采样（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 提出通过学习模型建立从问题实例到高质量QAOA变分角度参数的映射，用单次前向传播取代计算昂贵的逐实例非凸优化，速度提升数个数量级且质量几乎不变，并能泛化到未见过的图拓扑结构。
en_tdlr: We learn the mapping from problem instances to high-quality QAOA angles, replacing per-instance non-convex classical optimization with a single forward pass that is orders of magnitude faster while achieving near-identical quality and generalizing to unseen graph topologies.
